Maybank Championship: Charley Hull four shots off the lead after second round in Malaysia
Charley Hull shoots three-under 69 in Kuala Lumpur and sits in a share of fifth place as she chases leader Miyu Yamashita; watch round three from 1.30am on Saturday on Sky Sports Main Event and Sky Sports Mix
Friday 30 October 2026 13:38, UK
England's Charley Hull sits four shots off the lead after the second round of the LPGA's Maybank Championship in Malaysia.
Hull made five birdies in her first six holes to move into the lead but bogeyed two of her final three holes for a round of 69 and is now tied for fifth.
Defending champion Miyu Yamashita shot a six-under 66 to take a two-stroke lead in Kuala Lumpur, with the 2025 Women's Open winner 13 under after two rounds.

"I've been playing some really good rounds this year especially," Yamashita said. "My game is in better shape than last year, so my swing feels really good, too."
Julia Lopez Ramirez birdied three of her final four holes for a 66 and was tied for second with Pauline Roussin-Bouchard, who led by a stroke after the first round.
"Try to keep your mind cool and your body hydrated in these conditions," Lopez Ramirez said of her preparations for the weekend in the usual high humidity in Kuala Lumpur.
A Lim Kim had the round of the day, a 64, and was in fourth place, three strokes behind Yamashita.
Haeran Ryu, a major winner this year at the Women's PGA Championship and at the Evian Championship, withdrew before her first-round tee time due to a strained finger ligament she suffered while riding in a golf cart during the Wednesday pro-am.
She was the highest-ranked player in the tournament in the absence of world No 1 Nelly Korda and No 2 Jeeno Thitikul.
Yuri Yoshida, who won the BMW Ladies Championship in South Korea, shot 70 Friday and was at five under.
